title: Anthropic · 定价来源更新
summary: Tokens 定义说明文本有增删，内容实质未变，属于文档微调。

added_lines: Tokens are pieces of text that models process. How many tokens the same text produces depends on the model’s tokenizer, the language, and the type of content. Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview (claude-mythos-preview) use a newer tokenizer that produces approximately 30 percent more tokens for the same text than earlier models. To see how many tokens a request uses on a specific model, count it with Token counting and that model’s ID.
